title: HERON REACH
status: PROPOSED DESIGN / NOT A PLAYTESTED MAP
mode: 16v16 / three capture areas; test 8v8 and 12v12 before 16v16
coordinates: x east, z south; origin north-west; y height. North is up on every plan.

levels.title: UNDERCROFT
levels.description: Partial service loop; four exits, no spawn rooms.

levels.title: GROUND + GARDENS
levels.description: Three contested spaces, homes, shops and protected starts.

levels.title: GALLERIES + MAISONETTES
levels.description: Continuous gallery loop; two exposed bridge crossings.

levels.title: UPPER HOMES
levels.description: Four separate residential islands; no floating cross-court floor.

levels.title: LIMITED ROOF ROUTES
levels.description: North-west and south-east only; two stair exits per terrace.

H1.name: THROUGH FLAT / ONE BED
H1.description: Two public-facing exits via a 1.5 m hall. Bedroom and bath are optional rooms, not compulsory through-routes.

H2.name: SPLIT-LEVEL MAISONETTE / TWO BED
H2.description: Lower gallery entry and upper rear landing exit. Private stairs form a slower alternative to public cores.

validationBoundary: Design connectivity graph and metric drawing checks only. Not collision/navmesh, multiplayer capacity, dynamic respawn, combat balance or frame-time verification. All lighting and foliage counts are design placements, not new runtime assets.
